slice: Municipal Lobby + Records Annex playable slice
sampleRate: 44100 Hz (music/SFX render) / 22050 Hz (voice TTS render), all exported mono OGG Vorbis

cues.purpose: Seamless rain-blue bureaucratic-noir ambience bed for the Municipal Lobby; loops under all lobby gameplay.
Drier, dustier ticking-clock ambience bed for the Records Annex; swaps in when the player enters via elevator.
Short wry success stinger layered over the ambience bed when the current puzzle step resolves.
Soft high blip on menu/hotspot hover; low-volume, no harsh transient.
Two-tone confirmation blip when a UI choice or hotspot is selected.
Soft descending blip when backing out of a menu or dialogue choice.
Footstep on lobby/annex tile floor, variant 1; alternate with variant 2 per step.
Footstep on lobby/annex tile floor, variant 2; alternate with variant 1 per step.
Filing-drawer slide-and-knock when the player opens the filing drawer.
Paper rustle when the damaged form (or any paper item) is picked up.
Satisfying thunk-clack when the Paper Clerk stamps the form.
Soft two-tone click when the elevator call button is pressed / becomes usable.
Bell ding plus mechanical thunk as the elevator arrives and doors open.
Binder creak and paper rustle when the civic calendar ledger is opened.
Bright four-note discovery chime when the missing-Tuesday clue is found in the ledger.
Terse synthesized coo when the pigeon tube courier is interacted with; used sparingly.
Short stamp-and-chime SFX sting on puzzle-step resolution, layered with the music stinger.
Indoor-drizzle ambience bed for Floor 2, drier/colder companion to scene_lobby_ambience; built from CC0 Freesound rain + drone layers, seamless 64s loop.
Mechanical chunk when the take-a-number dispenser finally dispenses a ticket (Ch.1 Puzzle 1.1).
Officer Dill's hesitant, shakier stamp -- distinct from clerk_stamp -- when he self-authorizes Form S-1 (Ch.2).
Discovery chime for the Weather Control Panel pattern reveal (Ch.2) -- same family as clue_missing_tuesday, distinct timbre.

voiceDialogueNote: Chapter 1 voice lines are no longer listed cue-by-cue here -- superseded by script/CHAPTER_01_DIALOGUE.json, the authoritative per-line dialogue/timing manifest (line_id, speaker, final text, audio_filename, duration_s, and null placeholders for future word/phoneme timestamps). That file is generated straight from the locked script text in script/chapter-01-municipal-lobby.md, so it will not drift from it the way a hand-copied manifest entry could.
sourcingNote: Most cues are original procedurally-synthesized audio. A small set of Ch.2 cues (flagged below) are instead built from curated CC0/CC-BY Freesound material -- see AUDIO_CREDITS.md for full attribution and source links. sourced:freesound is set on those cue entries; all others are sourced:synthesized by omission.
